$description: Base motion: durations and easing curves. CSS transitions and anime.js tweens draw their timing here.

duration.$description: Closed set: invariant duration-scale admits no transition or tween duration outside it.

squish.$description: Segmented-pill squish bounce. One home for the nav, the 3D/2D toggle, and the accessibility Segmented (site-header / page / portfolio-accessibility read var(--duration-squish)).

reveal.$description: Section scroll-reveal spring (scroll-reveal.tsx). A watchable entrance, longer than settle's overshoot.

long.$description: A dismissal meant to be watched rather than got through. Sits 20ms from settle (780); the two are near-duplicates and one of them should absorb the other if a third consumer ever wants this length.

cycle.$description: One full logo-bounce cycle: enter, hold, exit, gap. The splash reveal runs exactly one of these, reversed. logo-bounce.tsx LOGO_CYCLE_MS must equal it (invariant P4).

ease.$description: The CSS curves, as DTCG control-point arrays. anime.js spring-family eases are not cubic beziers, are not CSS-emitted, and are therefore not tokens; their inventory is in decisions.md.
